note: Cross-blind 풀이 — 정답 재배치 후 재검증

solves.reason: (A) A violin sounds brighter — brighter. (B) makes sound subjectively louder — louder. (C) a short-lived effect — short-lived. ③ brighter-louder-short-lived.
(A) can be calculated — calculated. (B) will immediately like — immediately. (C) it is wise — wise. ④ calculated-immediately-wise.
(A) many more overtones — overtones. (B) subjectively louder — subjectively. (C) to convince the musician — convince. ② overtones-subjectively-convince.
원문 immediately → ③ gradually는 반대 의미로 부적절.
원문 obvious → ② obscure는 반대 의미로 부적절.
원문 less brightness → ④ more는 반대 의미로 부적절.
'it makes sound subjectively _____' — louder가 원문. ④ louder.
'to _____ the musician that less brightness serves his music better' — convince. ③.
'which can be _____ from the sounds easily' — calculated. ②.
obvious = 분명한. ① clear(분명한)가 동의어.
subjectively = 주관적으로. ③ personally(개인적으로)가 가장 가까운 동의어.
immediately = 즉시. ③ instantly(즉각적으로)가 동의어.
louder 반의어 = ② quieter(더 조용한).
wise 반의어 = ② foolish(어리석은). careful은 유사 방향이므로 제외.
(A) play back a track = 재생하다. (B) play in the park = 놀다. ④ 재생하다-놀다.
주음 위 추가 소리 = overtones(배음). ① overtones.
can be + p.p. 수동태. calculate → calculated.
compared to = ~와 비교하면. compare → compared (과거분사 분사구문).
'But this is _____, and in the long run' — 역접+장기 대조 → ① a short-lived effect.
'part of _____, and in the classical music of the 19th century' — 현대 전자음악과 병렬. ④ the loudness war in modern electronic music.
